rows.note: 7d to 2026-10-07: 36 main-context RESUMEs (11.2M, 89%) each carry a new brief into a 60-260k context the chat chose to keep (CLAUDE.md same-session rule), cache past Claude Code's own 1h TTL; the only cheaper path, a fresh worker with a distilled brief, drops that context and cannot replay to identical decisions; 115 image-gen sidechain 5m expiries (1.4M, 11%) already gone at source (claude-setup 4f0dcd0 1h TTL, 01f7357 agent removed); worker-run's RESUME-COLD warning prints after the decision into the relay, which never forwards it, so it changes nothing
